verdict.rationale: Loops' homepage directly claims it can show which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue, so revenue attribution is a first-party capability. That claim is a single marketing line with no documentation of how attribution works or what it covers. Missing for 10: documented attribution mechanics (revenue or conversion event tracking and attribution model), explicit signup attribution, per-workflow/flow-level attribution reporting, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks

citations.quote: See which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue.
